entries.concept: Rooftop crate year above a music rehearsal loft
entries.creativeDirection: Photorealistic daylight location photography of a rooftop rehearsal loft, using large physical "2021" digits built from vinyl crates as the lead subject and translating the album-cover motifs into real studio objects, painted surfaces, and carefully staged portraits.
entries.scene: A wide 16:9 view into and across the roof terrace of a converted industrial music rehearsal space, seen from a slightly elevated neighboring rooftop so the giant digits read clearly while the loft interior and terrace details spread around them.

elements.element: the man from reference image 1 staged as a large centered chest-up portrait visible through a loft window, preserving his forward pose, closed eyes, glasses, bare shoulders, and vivid red background with blue light on his skin
a large painted sunburst mural on a rooftop wall: yellow radiating spikes on red with a blue center and two black oval eye-like forms
the terrace floor and a wall panel carry a smooth red-to-orange gradient field with faint dark stencil-like marks near the top edge

the two men from reference image 4 appear once together in a close black-and-white portrait on a freestanding rehearsal-room backdrop just inside the loft, preserving their tight framing and direct camera presence
the young man from reference image 5 appears once in a pale blue-framed black-and-white inset-style portrait mounted beside a pillar, preserving his turned-back pose and bare shoulders
a delicate translucent yellow mesh ribbon hangs diagonally between roof posts above the terrace
blue, turquoise, copper, and gold painterly swirls become a glossy tarpaulin draped over equipment cases and a section of roof surface

a cutaway caravan parked on the terrace edge, packed with the eclectic interior details: chandelier, fireplace, red chair, the seated person hidden behind a newspaper, Dalmatian, tree, telephone with lizard, and other curios

coverSummaries.description: A studio portrait of one bare-shouldered man shown from the chest up against a vivid red background. His skin is lit in bright blue, creating a strong red-blue contrast. He has shoulder-length dark hair, closed eyes, light facial stubble, and dark rectangular glasses. The composition is centered and symmetrical, with the figure facing forward.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: blue-lit portrait of a man with closed eyes and glasses
coverSummaries.people: one man facing forward with closed eyes, shoulder-length dark hair, glasses, and bare shoulders

coverSummaries.description: A bold abstract graphic on a red background featuring a large yellow sunburst-like shape with irregular radiating spikes. At the center is a rough blue oval containing two white outlined black oval forms that resemble eyes or openings. The image has a distressed, screen-printed look with thick flat colors.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: yellow sunburst with a blue face-like center and two black oval eyes
coverSummaries.people: none

coverSummaries.description: A minimal cover filled almost entirely by a smooth red-to-orange gradient field. Near the top center is a faint row of dark geometric stencil-like marks. The composition is sparse and flat, with no figures or objects besides the subtle marks.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: red-orange gradient field
coverSummaries.people: none

coverSummaries.description: A black-and-white close portrait of two young men filling most of the frame. One is on the left, slightly forward, with dark styled hair and an earring, wearing a dark zippered jacket. The other is on the right with curly dark hair and a knit sweater, facing the camera. The background is plain and softly lit, and the composition is tightly cropped around their faces and shoulders.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: close black-and-white portrait of two men
coverSummaries.people: two young men in a close portrait, one with styled dark hair and earring, one with curly hair and a knit sweater

coverSummaries.description: A pale blue cover with a centered black-and-white rectangular photograph. The photo shows one young man in profile or three-quarter back view, bare-shouldered, turning his head toward the camera beside a vertical wall or pillar. The layout uses large flat color areas around the inset image, with a horizontal pale band crossing the lower part of the photo.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: black-and-white inset portrait of a bare-shouldered young man turning back
coverSummaries.medium: graphic layout with inset black-and-white photograph
coverSummaries.people: one young man shown bare-shouldered, turned partly away and looking back

coverSummaries.description: A very minimal white cover with a delicate yellow mesh or net-like form floating diagonally across the center. The shape is airy and translucent, made of many fine intersecting lines, tapering at both ends like a drifting fabric or wireframe ribbon. Large empty white space surrounds it.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: floating yellow mesh-like ribbon form
coverSummaries.people: none

coverSummaries.description: An abstract cover divided visually into cool and warm zones, with sweeping painterly textures. The upper area is dominated by turquoise, cyan, and deep blue brush-like swirls, while the lower area glows with copper, gold, amber, and black. The composition feels glossy and layered, with broad gestural streaks and reflective surfaces.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: abstract blue-and-copper painterly swirls
coverSummaries.medium: abstract painting or manipulated painterly image
coverSummaries.people: none

coverSummaries.album: The Very Very Best Of Crowded House
coverSummaries.description: A whimsical illustrated cutaway caravan or trailer interior packed with objects. Inside are patterned wallpaper, a chandelier, a fireplace with flames, a red upholstered chair, a person seated behind an open newspaper, and a Dalmatian dog beside the chair. Other visible items include a large tree growing through the room, autumn leaves, a cuckoo clock, framed pictures, a ladder, stacked chairs, a dress form, a pineapple, a red rotary telephone with a green lizard on it, a television, toy soldiers, a sailboat model, planets hanging near a window, buildings, a cake, and scattered leaves. The trailer sits on a single visible wheel above black grass silhouettes, with a warm sunset sky around it.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: surreal cutaway caravan interior filled with eclectic objects
coverSummaries.people: one person seated in a red chair with face hidden behind an open newspaper

entries.concept: Seaside beds around dune-cut 2022
entries.creativeDirection: Photographic seaside location image with the year physically cut into coastal dunes, using the album motifs as real beach installations and carefully staged portraits.
entries.scene: A wide elevated coastal viewpoint looks across a beach at golden hour. Huge legible digits reading 2022 are cut cleanly into the face of pale sand dunes across the upper center of the frame, spanning more than half the image width. Below, rows of metal beds stand in shallow tidal water along the shoreline, with selected portraits and motifs staged among them as physical presences.

elements.element: a tall white egret-like bird with an orange beak stands prominently near the foreground beds, its white body crisp against sea and sand
the main environmental structure: long rows of metal-framed beds in shallow water on the beach, with the two small figures among the nearest beds and a small red-winged aircraft overhead

the illustrated woman is staged as a faithful live tableau seated sideways on a large suspended golden five-pointed star installation above one cluster of beds, with small planet-like beach balloons or sculptures nearby
the woman from reference image 4 reclines in translucent lavender fabric on one bed, closely flanked by her two large dogs
the woman from reference image 5 appears once only as a close shoulder-up portrait at a nearer bed, turned slightly sideways against a pale upright bedhead panel
three tall white-framed translucent panels stand near the surf, each catching the low sun and echoing the vertical flare motif
the man from reference image 7 appears once only within a freestanding grid of tinted square glass panels beside the beds, his repeated blurred portrait contained inside that single installation
a large painted beach parasol or circular sign carries the central jagged-grin devil face and surrounding orange-white burst pattern as a bold supporting graphic near midground

entries.concept: Winter atrium with suspended year
entries.creativeDirection: Daylight location photography in a real glass conservatory, using suspended plant-house structures as the dominant physical "2023" and staging the album motifs as tangible installations around them.
entries.scene: A large public conservatory or botanical glasshouse seen almost straight on from an elevated interior balcony, with four huge freestanding hanging greenhouse-frame digits spelling 2023 across the central void, surrounded by winter plant displays, shallow water basins, windows, and small artful installations derived from the album covers.

elements.element: A life-size headless mannequin in a loose green outfit and yellow shoes stands below the digits between two open pink-painted window frames, backed by a flat blue panel with a small crescent moon and dotted stars.

The two young men from reference image 2 appear once as a close shoulder-up black-and-white photographic portrait displayed inside a clean round conservatory lightbox, keeping their direct gaze and tight framing.
A surrounding arrangement of monochrome cropped face fragments and one hand appears as mounted photographic panels around a central tan display block on a side wall.
A bright yellow bird inside a geometric wire cage hangs among dry leaves, feathers, a moth, and small insects as a natural-history style installation near one of the digits.
A shallow rectangular indoor reflecting pool contains the dark floating figure from reference image 5 with briefcase, seen from above enough to keep the water pattern readable.
The long-haired person from reference image 6 appears once in a side room opening, leaning forward beside a tall sheer-curtained window, preserving the downward pose and silhouette.

The five men from reference image 7 stand grouped together in the distance, visible through a large circular opening structure with one oversized foreground hand resting on the lower rim and another gripping the right rim.
Layered jagged pale blue and white mountain forms with subtle digital-fracture edging become a large sculptural backdrop planted along the rear of the conservatory.

entries.concept: Planetary diner counter with stargazer portraits
entries.creativeDirection: Use daylight location photography to stage a crisp, physically plausible retro roadside diner terrace where cosmic and performance motifs appear as tangible props, signage, and decor, while the sleeve portraits remain fixed in their original poses within the scene.
entries.scene: A wide 16:9 exterior view of a retro roadside diner forecourt and terrace under clear hard midday sun, shot from slightly below eye level so the counter frontage, terrace tables, and open sky all read cleanly; the setting is real and sunlit, with sharp shadows, chrome details, and a big expanse of blue sky above.

elements.element: A giant glass vacuum tube lies horizontally along the diner counter like a sculptural display case, its metal pins prominent at one end and its amber-tinted glass catching the sun.

The person from reference image 2 stands close to the camera at one side of the terrace in the same front-facing pose with both hands thrust toward the lens, with small star-shaped hanging lights and fingertip star glows suspended around them.
The young man from reference image 3 remains seated on a scooter seen from behind, parked near the curb outside the diner, still wearing the jacket with the circular target emblem.

Abstract blue human silhouettes become painted mural panels on the diner's exterior wall, flattened into graphic signage-like decoration with one dominant pale blue figure and accents of red lettering-inspired striping.

A server's arm in a dark sleeve extends from a service window holding a silver tray carrying a miniature Earth globe, fresh sunflowers and daisies, a white dove perched among them, and an orange butterfly nearby.
A toy-like coin-operated kiddie rocket ride beside the entrance carries the devil-faced figure as a real sculpted amusement object, angled upward with carnival colors and small star decals.
At the far end of the terrace, the performer from reference image 7 is seen from behind with both arms raised toward a tightly packed daytime crowd gathered beyond a low barrier in the forecourt.

Translucent amber and red dice scattered across a reflective stainless-steel public ledge or ashtray tray beside the booth, with a few cylindrical metal cups or bollard tops nearby and thin white line markings resembling card-suit doodles etched or painted on the booth glass.
The four silhouetted performers appear as a flat orange street poster or painted mural on a side wall, with sweeping white curves integrated as graphic public-art lines, kept secondary in scale.

A large owl with wings spread rendered as a realistic sculptural relief or painted security-shutter mural above a dark basement grate or service opening, echoing the original forward-facing stance without turning the whole scene fantastical.
A haloed angel translated into a weathered mosaic, devotional tile panel, or small shrine image mounted on the wall near the booth, leaning diagonally as in the source and reading as urban found art.
The glass phone booth and city sidewalk structure the entire composition, with a few tiny distant pedestrians and passing cars far in the background only.

entries.prompt: A sun-struck Mediterranean-style courtyard photographed straight on in a medium-wide 16:9 editorial composition, with pale stone paving, limewashed walls, and a central plinth or shallow fountain basin establishing a strong axis. The primary subject is a large weathered stone statuary group on the plinth echoing the dramatic classical tableau from reference image 4: a snake-wrapped male figure, an elevated draped figure, clustered bodies, and carved animal forms, all treated as plausible old garden sculpture rather than live performers. Behind it, the back wall is dominated by a hand-painted mural from reference image 1: a vivid red field, a bold yellow sunburst, and a blue face-like center with oversized black oval eyes. Along one side wall, integrate the repeating side-profile silhouettes from reference image 2 as hot-pink, black, and white poster-like bands, with the tiny standing woman from reference image 2 appearing once inside a narrow white inset near the upper left. Build the paving and low wall trim from reference image 3 into a red-and-purple geometric tile grid with note-like shapes, yellow horizontal bands, and a slim torn white vertical strip with black marks on the right side of the composition. Place a bold black-and-white banner or painted foreground shape from reference image 5 near the bottom edge, showing the crouching silhouette with chain and a dotted circular form behind it. On a side wall, include the four men from reference image 6 once as a single large pasted portrait panel, keeping their close-up fragmented faces and purple paint-block obscurations intact. At the left edge, in the cool darkness of a doorway, stage the woman from reference image 7 exactly once, preserving her shadowed partial visibility and the long narrow white garment shape edged in red. Overhead, stretch a marbled black-gray-white fabric canopy inspired by reference image 8, with an irregular bright white opening at its center framing the sky. Photographic realism, clean editorial location shoot, crisp focus, no haze, no fog, no wet surfaces. Hard midday sun with sharp shadows, bright reflected light in the courtyard, saturated colors, graphic contrast, and a clear hierarchy from central sculpture to mural to portraits; palette of red, yellow, blue, hot pink, black, white, purple, and sunlit stone, mood enigmatic but bright and sharply legible. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 4 shows several people in a staged classical tableau, including multiple partially nude adults; reference image 6 shows four men shown in close-up portrait fragments; reference image 7 shows one woman partially visible in shadow. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.

entries.prompt: A wide 16:9 outdoor pool complex in bright overcast daylight, viewed from slightly above deck level so the terrace, concrete steps, changing-room wall, and a monument plaza beyond align in one realistic continuous space; the woman from reference image 3 is the central subject on the pool deck in close portrait scale, wearing the white swim cap decorated with pale yellow flowers and green leaves, with dark eyeliner, red lipstick, and the same slightly sideways gaze; at the near left foreground edge, the person from reference image 1 appears in extreme close-up with hand near mouth, face blue-tinted by reflected pool light, surrounded by a few soft warm yellow-orange globe lights, and a subtle jagged yellow line painted on a nearby wall echoes the neon tracing; at the near right foreground edge, the shirtless person from reference image 2 is cropped from chest to upper arm with the crucifix pendant and rose tattoo clearly visible; the man from reference image 5 stands in the midground by a pool rail against a soft pink wall, looking directly outward and holding a cigarette near his face; the tattooed person from reference image 6 sits on the concrete steps in the same bowed crouch with boots and striped socks; the bearded man from reference image 7 sits alone on a tall lifeguard-style stool in an open white deck zone, wearing cowboy hat, sunglasses, fitted white T-shirt, and light shorts, head tipped down with one bare foot extended; beyond them all, a large black winged angel monument from reference image 4 rises at the far end with one arm raised holding a wreath-like object and the other extended, horse-head statuary low at its base; the abstract face from reference image 8 appears as a large coral mural on a poolside wall made of thin black horizontal lines forming a centered nose and brow, with purple, blue, teal, and yellow geometric shapes beneath; daylight location photography, clean editorial realism, crisp focus on all identifiable faces, medium-format clarity; layered composition with the swim-cap portrait as the anchor, cropped foreground bodies framing the scene, seated figures stepping back into depth, and the angel statue as the distant vertical climax; bright even overcast light, saturated but natural color, pool blues balanced by coral, pink, white, black, and small yellow-orange accents; poised, surreal, graphic yet physically plausible. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 1 shows one person in extreme close-up with a hand near the mouth; reference image 2 shows one shirtless person shown from chest to upper arm; reference image 3 shows one woman in close-up wearing a swim cap with flowers; reference image 5 shows one man in close-up portrait holding a cigarette; reference image 6 shows one seated tattooed person with head bowed on steps; reference image 7 shows one bearded man seated on a stool wearing a cowboy hat and sunglasses. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. entries.prompt: Huge physically painted runway digits "2026" spanning at least half the width of a small rural airfield apron, seen from a slightly elevated near-face-on viewpoint so the numbers read flat and bold in the upper two-thirds of the frame; around and behind the year, stage a crisp real-world morning scene with the person from reference image 1 standing on the grassy verge behind the digits, back to camera, wide-legged with hands clasped behind the back, wearing the long red, white, and blue flag-patterned coat; the woman from reference image 2 reclining on translucent lavender fabric at the tarmac edge beside one digit with the two large dogs pressed against her in the same intimate pose; the two women from reference image 4 posed beside a yellow-green hangar wall in their pale blue and white floral kimonos, one with white face makeup holding her cheeks open-mouthed, the other smiling with one eye closed and holding an open fan; the blonde woman from reference image 6 near the digits wearing a sparkling crown and heavy streaked eye makeup, mouth open, clutching a wrapped bouquet; the two small children from reference image 7 seated together on a white chair near the apron edge, smiling, with an orange repeating patterned shade panel behind them; include the rose tattoo on a bare upper arm and hanging cross pendant from reference image 5 as a single close foreground body detail at the lower edge only; translate reference image 3 into a red horned winged safety-marker cutout or painted airfield sign near a service wall with a blue opening and warm swirling graphics; translate reference image 8 into translucent prism-like markers and thin white cables creating real rainbow light bands across the tarmac. Photographic realism, daylight location photography, clean lens, high clarity, no haze, no fog, no heavy grain. Compose with the year as the dominant first read and the portraits as supporting vignettes arranged clearly without overlapping faces. Use low-angle early morning sunlight with crisp long shadows, bright blue sky, saturated but natural color. Palette of runway white, sky blue, fresh green, lavender, red, yellow-green, orange, and small rainbow accents; mood celebratory, open, fresh, and slightly surreal but believable. The year "2026" appears exactly once as runway-painted digits on airfield, built into the scene and lit like the rest of the photograph. It is the dominant subject and the first thing the eye reads: the digits span at least half the width of the frame, sit high or centred rather than along the bottom edge, and read face-on and legibly at thumbnail size, with the album motifs and people arranged around it. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 1 shows one person standing with back to camera in a long patterned coat; reference image 2 shows one woman reclining in sheer fabric with two dogs against her; reference image 4 shows two women posing in patterned kimonos, one with white face makeup and one holding a fan; reference image 5 shows one partially visible person shown as a bare torso and arm; reference image 6 shows one blonde woman wearing a crown and holding flowers; reference image 7 shows two small children smiling close together. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. The only lettering anywhere in the image is the year "2026": those four digits, spelled exactly 2 0 2 6, appearing once, large and legible, as a physical part of the scene rather than an overlay. Include no other readable text or lettering of any kind: no other words, letters, numbers, dates, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
